purpose: The date field of a level's popover in the value graph, as one component: a labelled date input that tells the host on change, on Enter, on blur and on Escape, and shows the year alert when the host asks for it.
namedChanges: the field is lifted into one component whose state and handlers are props (`setBadYearFor(...)` became `onYearCheck`, `commitWhen(openAt, value)` became `onCommit`, `setOpen(null)` became `onEscape`); the `key` stays with the host; the alert's visibility is the `showYearError` prop.
The markup and classes are as in the source. Comments are rewritten.

library.title: Date picker for a level
library.note: The date field of a level's popover in the value graph; the year rules are in date-rules. The Levels line's own dates are in value-levels-line. Plan.Value
